rules.statement: No token balance, AI output or candidate record grants governance authority.
rules.required_evidence: Current Principal, assignment, delegation and Decision

rules.statement: Every decision actor has a recognized Principal, current scoped Role Assignment and any required Delegation.
rules.required_evidence: Identity and assignment cut at decision time

rules.statement: Proposer, evidence reviewers, approvers and executors satisfy the action matrix and required separation.
rules.required_evidence: Distinct Principal IDs and action profile version

rules.statement: Conflicts and common control are disclosed; conflicted actors recuse from review, approval and execution.
Every research or economic decision binds exact source, object, policy and counterevidence versions.
Task and cash liabilities are reserved inside cleared budget and epoch cap before assignment.
Work review has at least two independent evidence-linked reviewers with verified review quality.
rules.required_evidence: Two sealed reviews and quality audit

rules.statement: W award follows valid task gates, appeal closure and exact owner decision; result sign alone cannot change the bounty.
rules.required_evidence: Task, reviews, decision and ledger refs

rules.statement: U allocation follows independent novelty or new-information review, causal attribution, signed agreement and pre-reserved milestone.
rules.required_evidence: Prior search, run, attribution, agreement and owner decision

rules.statement: Stablecoin settlement uses audited receipts, active-unit snapshot, Product authorization and two distinct treasury signers.
rules.required_evidence: Statement, contract, signer and finality receipts

rules.statement: Product, source, IP and personal-data use require their own rights and consent decisions.
rules.required_evidence: Rights policy, license, consent and Product decision

rules.statement: Rule changes are versioned, disclosed, prospective and delayed; accepted terms keep their original version.
rules.required_evidence: Diff, impact review, disclosure and effective time

rules.statement: Emergency pause is scoped, evidenced, time-bounded and independently co-signed; resume follows fresh audit.
rules.required_evidence: Incident, scope, duration, second signer and audit

rules.statement: Appeals use independent adjudicators and append compensating corrections without rewriting history.
rules.required_evidence: Appeal case, original decision, new evidence and remedy

rules.statement: Every epoch and revenue period receives independent reconciliation and exception monitoring.
rules.required_evidence: Ledger root, audit report and unresolved exception list

rules.statement: Funder grants, W purchases and any separate revenue rights have distinct instruments and do not issue research U.
rules.required_evidence: Signed instrument, disclosure and legal decision

rules.statement: Affected contributors, funders and customers receive the exact disclosure and challenge path specified by their task or agreement.

change_rule: A changed meaning creates a new version; old decisions retain their exact rule version.
claim_ceiling: Candidate governance rules only; no adopted policy or operative permission.
